description: "Golden Steps to Respectability, Usefulness and Happiness" by John Mather Austin is a collection of lectures aimed at youth, written in the mid-19th century. The text focuses on foundational principles of character development, moral integrity, and social conduct, intending to guide young individuals towards a life of respectability, usefulness, and happiness.
